title: How long do these animals live?
prompt: Place each animal by its typical maximum lifespan.

items.label: Adult mayfly
items.fact: Adult mayflies live a day or less — just long enough to reproduce.

items.label: House mouse
items.fact: Wild mice rarely reach their second birthday; predators and cold take most.

items.label: Domestic dog
items.fact: Smaller breeds tend to outlive larger ones by several years.

items.label: Human
items.fact: Global average life expectancy is about 73 years, up from roughly 32 a century ago.

items.label: Giant tortoise
items.fact: Some Galápagos tortoises alive today hatched before the light bulb was invented.

items.label: Greenland shark
items.fact: Greenland sharks may live 300–400 years — the longest-lived vertebrate known.
